main.description: Change the audience of an existing postPrivate record in the writer's own repository. Only audienceList changes; the URI stays the same and the record CID changes. Replies are refused, since a reply's audience is its thread's.

repo.description: DID of the writer's repository. Must be the authenticated account.

rkey.description: Record key of the post to update.

audienceList.description: AT-URI of one of the writer's own policy.audience records.

swapRecord.description: Compare and swap with the post's current record CID.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The post does not exist or is a reply, or audienceList does not name an existing audience record of the writer's.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller may not write to this repository, or the host does not allow this account private-tier writes.

errors.name: UnsupportedNamespace
errors.description: The host does not have the private tier enabled.

errors.name: InvalidSwap
errors.description: swapRecord did not match the post's current record CID.
